description: Impacts Sociologiques et Environnementaux des Incendies en Grèce (2015-2025) is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by European Fire Prevention & Rural Preservation Organization (EFPRP). Ce jeu de données présente une synthèse quantitative et qualitative extraite du rapport stratégique "The Ashen Legacy: A Comprehensive Analysis of the Sociological and Environmental Impacts of Wildfire in Greece (2015-2025)", publié par l'Organisation Européenne de Prévention des Incendies et de Préservation Rurale (European Fire Prevention & Rural Preservation Organization EFPRP). Coverage: European Fire Prevention & Rural Preservation Organization (EFPRP). The publisher named on the listing is European Fire Prevention & Rural Preservation Organization (EFPRP). Its keywords include environnement, efprp, 2015, donnees-ouvertes, changement-climatique, feux-de-forets. The listing shows 4 download or service links in CSV, PDF, TXT. The listing shows 2025-12-21 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
